content.short: Sepior is a multi-asset wallet platform powered by Sepior's Advanced MPC™.
content.description: Sepior MPC Wallet is a multi-chain wallet platform that uses Sepior’s Advanced MPC technology to deliver secure, policy-driven key management across networks. PolicyProtect prevents unwanted policy changes by cryptographically binding policies to key shares, strengthening control and security. The MPC framework allows key shares to generate partial signatures online or offline, reducing exposure. Developers can integrate the wallet via APIs, plug-ins, and webhooks, with support for Ethereum, BNB Chain, Polygon, Arbitrum, Avalanche, Bitcoin, Base, and Solana.
